## Selected work

- AI Avtojavob / Aylo (Cresta): AI-powered sales automation that connects Instagram, Telegram, Facebook and WhatsApp, turns Instagram comments matching keywords into AI direct-message replies, with custom prompts, admin consoles and self-serve onboarding.
- Sifat Nazorat (Toshkent Sinov Xizmati): quality-control platform for laboratory testing and product certification with QR-code verification pages, dynamic product and producer routes, Next.js, TypeScript, MongoDB and Supabase Auth.
- Frutera (Cresta Systems, team project with Ilyosbek Axmedjanov): export-logistics ERP that replaced the spreadsheets and group chats of an agricultural-export company. Ingests from watched Telegram groups (MTProto), the Uzbek customs portal (E-IMZO signature), Google Sheets and a WhatsApp bridge; Claude extracts shipments, declarations and payments; a nightly pass reconciles client ledgers. Next.js CRM (40 pages, 150 API endpoints, 38 PostgreSQL tables), Telegram Mini App and Android app for field entry. ~105k lines, 6 Docker services.
- Cresta: corporate website, Telegram bot and CRM for a newly founded development company.
- T-SX (Toshkent Sinov Xizmati): corporate website with a news CMS, photo gallery and admin interface.
- Fimtext: landing page for a textile testing and quality-control laboratory.

## Skills

- Languages: JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML5, CSS3
- Frontend: React, Next.js, Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui
- State and data: Redux Toolkit, Zustand, TanStack Query, React Hook Form, Zod
- Backend: Node.js, Express.js, REST APIs
- Databases and services: MongoDB, PostgreSQL, Supabase
- Authentication: Supabase Auth, JWT, HTTP-only cookies
- AI and automation: AI API integrations, n8n, Telegram Bot API, social media API integrations
- DevOps and tools: Git, GitHub, Docker, Vercel, Cloudflare, Linux/WSL
